bio.text: Bryan McCarty is the Democratic candidate for Wyoming Secretary of State in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists him as advancing from the August 18 Democratic primary.
In his WyoFile election guide response, McCarty says he was born in Mansfield, Ohio, and now lives in Worland.
He describes his career as mostly in the railroad industry, with internal audit and Six Sigma training.
